defect_list.title: QuickCreate Create button onClick never fires
defect_list.evidence_summary: uiautomator shows the Create button wrapper at [804,105][1036,237] with clickable=true enabled=true long-clickable=true, yet Compose onClick never fires on tap. Multiple input-tap / input-swipe (zero-displacement) / input-motionevent DOWN/UP variants register MotionEvent in logcat but no follow-up Compose click handler fires; no /v1/timeline/* POST issued. defect_list.title: Tile-detail source-tile 404: /v1/tiles/{id} returns NOT_FOUND for the Start Point tile visible on the timeline
defect_list.discovered_during: D2 path continuation after XIG03 reconnect 2026-09-15 20:18 JST (PM-directive step 'D2 → start/completionまで連続実行')
defect_list.evidence_summary: Tapping the Start Point tile on the timeline opens a ModalBottomSheet in peek state (heading 'Tile', tabs イベント/タスク/繰り返し, '—' placeholder, 'Retry' button). Drag-up swipe at the handle [474,1818][606,1951] does not transition the sheet to Expanded on this connection. Tapping the Retry button DOES fire Compose onClick and DOES call /v1/tiles/{id} on the production backend, but v1 returns Api(kindValue=4, kindName=NOT_FOUND, message='source tile 01a0a3f2-e09e-7ea1-a58b-58ee70b7eea5', currentRevision=null). Three consecutive Retry taps produced three identical NOT_FOUND responses in logcat at 20:20:34, 20:20:36, 20:20:37 (3-second client-side back-off between attempts).
defect_list.open_question_distinct_from_A05_A: This is NOT a UI-wiring issue (the onClick fires, the API is called). It is a v1 backend state inconsistency: the same 'Start Point' placement renders on the Day view timeline (so the timeline aggregate endpoint returns it), but the corresponding source-tile row referenced by that placement returns NOT_FOUND in /v1/tiles/{id}. Without a resolved tile-detail payload, no edit / start / complete affordance is reachable in this view.
defect_list.scope_decision_pending_pm: Per PM directive this is 'the next failure point in the D2 chain' and qualifies as the new single blocker. Underlying cause is a v1 seed-state inconsistency (a placement references a source tile that does not exist on the v1 backend for this user); fixing requires either v1 data-state repair or an Android client fallback. As of 2026-09-15 20:20 JST, this is recorded without a fix-attempt; no DB INSERT and no API contract change is being applied. Re-judgement only after PM authorizes a tier of repair (seed-DB via operator action B / Android client 404 placeholder / API relax), which is presently out of scope.
